summary: Temporary danger area EGD174A active near EGLC for drone flights beyond visual line of sight, up to 700 ft, 2 nautical mile radius.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD174A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 093/2026 
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE 
TDA. EMERG SER AND MIL OPS REQUIRING IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO THE TDA 
SHOULD CTC HEATHROW RADAR ON 125.625MHZ. FOR OTHER CREWED
ACFT OR VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT OPS ACCESS, CTC THE OPR 72 HR PRIOR
TO OPS COMMENCING ON 01332 319137 OR VIA EMAIL TO 
FLIGHTOPS.UK(AT)MATTERNET.COM. FURTHER DETAILS VIA 
WWW.NATS-UK.EAD-IT.COM.
AR-2026-4900/00.
